newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul says Dutch sex harassment charge fabricated.
newsitem.headline: Seoul says Dutch sex harassment charge fabricated.

text.p: The South Korean Foreign Ministry said on Saturday it believed the charge of sexual harassment brought against Seoul's ambassador to the Netherlands by his cook were fabricated.
"Judging on reports from our embassy in the Netherlands, we would say the sexual abuse charge was fabricated," a ministry spokesman said by telephone.
The Indonesian cook levelled the charges at ambassador Kyung-Chul Kim after she was threatened with dismissal for poor performance, the spokesman said.
The cook had been told that unless she improved, she would be sent home to Indonesia, he added.
"She appears to have falsely accused Kim in an attempt to get some kind of compensation for what she thinks was bad treatment by our embassy there."
Kim would not give up his right to diplomatic immunity.
"Kim has the right to refuse the request by the local prosecutor's office for an interview. He is expected to deal with the legal procedures only through his lawyer," the sopkesman said.
Dutch police said on Friday they were investigating the sexual abuse complaint.

A spokeswoman for the public prosecutor's office in the Netherlands said an application would be made in the mext few days to the Dutch Foreign Ministry to waive the ambassador's diplomatic immunity so he could be interviewed.
